# benthepythondev

> Web data products by benthepythondev: managed B2B data feeds, free EU and US rental yield benchmarks with CSV samples, Reddit archive data samples, Memberwall paid Telegram memberships, and a catalog of production Apify and RapidAPI scrapers with step-by-step guides that show real output rows.

## Product hubs
- [Managed B2B Data Feeds](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/feeds/): scheduled JSON, CSV, webhook, S3 or Snowflake delivery from 15 production scrapers, $199 to $999 a month, free 10-row sample.
- [EU & US Rental Yield & Price-Cut Benchmarks](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/yield/): gross yield, price per m², price-to-rent and price-cut share for markets in Spain, Italy, Portugal and the US, each with a free 25-row CSV. Full table: https://benthepythondev00.github.io/yield/summary.csv
- [Reddit Archive Data Samples](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/data/reddit-archive-scraper/): real archived Reddit rows, every field with an example value, and the per-row price.
- [Memberwall](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/memberwall/): paid access to a Telegram channel or group, paid in Telegram Stars or directly, flat fee, no revenue share.
- [RapidAPI developer integration kits](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/): OpenAPI 3.1 specs, code snippets, n8n workflows and MCP tool definitions. Details: https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/llms.txt
- [Custom Apify Actor development](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/custom-apify-actor.html): a new scraper for an uncovered site in 1 to 3 days from $150.
